summary: In web/src/bridge.ts (the only file changed), I added an exported startShellStore() immediately after storeOfGlobal(), returning storeOfGlobal(), with the doc comment about making the dashboard's store now so it hears change events from app start. I call startShellStore() once at module level right after its definition, so the store subscribes to the shell's onChange at app load rather than on the first useShell() call. I also updated the doc comments of shellStore and useShell to say the store is made at start via startShellStore, not at the first useShell(). No other bodies changed and no test files were edited. All checks pass: pnpm --dir web test (586 tests, 25 files), tsc -b, and lint.
concerns: The test file imports startShellStore() and calls it after a change event; my implementation returns the same held store, verified passing.
Module-level startShellStore() reads the global once at import time; a shell global set later still gets a store via storeOfGlobal's raw comparison.
